new_postulate: Triangle normals supply auxiliary positive null seed vectors, not final photon momenta. Apply the unique rotation-free rest boost of their timelike total and one common dilation to the independently supplied incoming CM energy M.
orientation_convention: Triangle normals follow the listed ordered vertex tuples ACE/BDF and ADe/BDe/CDe. Relabellings must transport orientations, not re-sort vertices or flip signs to fit observations. Their physical readout binding is not derived.
baseline_weights: Proportional to triangle areas. Equal-area source examples use common-area units; unequal-weight sensitivity inputs are not source-selected predictions.
domain: Positive-energy null seeds with future-timelike total; M>0. A single ray or wholly parallel positive rays are excluded.
falsifier: Failure of nullness, positive energy, conserved total (M,0,0,0), rotation covariance, common-scale/permutation consistency or inverse reconstruction with retained boost/scale data. Physical falsification additionally requires independently bound geometry, seed weights and photon readout.
